subject: [PATCH 6/6] test/daxctl-devices.sh: cycle offline/online to cover unplug and replug

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the test script for daxctl devices to include a cycle of online and offline operations, simulating device unplug and re-plug scenarios. The changes cover cases where a device is brought online from an unplugged state and vice versa, as well as checking that memory can be unplugged even if it's already offline. Additionally, the script checks block counts and kernel memory states after each operation to ensure correctness.
